responsibilities: Lead administration and continuous improvement of the Power BI environment
Define governance, security, modeling, and deployment standards
Design reusable, scalable datasets that promote metric consistency across teams
Improve platform performance, reliability, and cost efficiency
Architect and implement dimensional models in Snowflake using dbt
Build durable analytics layers aligned to core revenue and operational domains
Ensure strong alignment between warehouse structures and reporting logic
Embed testing, documentation, and performance optimization into standard engineering practice
Define and formalize KPI logic with clear business definitions and ownership
Maintain consistency of metrics across tools, systems, and reporting surfaces
Resolve conflicting definitions through structured analysis and stakeholder alignment
Strengthen transparency and trust in enterprise data assets
Treat AI as a core capability in modern analytics, leveraging it to deliver high-quality solutions with greater speed and rigor
Design data models and governance patterns that enable the organization to safely and effectively leverage AI with trusted data
Integrate AI into analytics workflows to accelerate modeling, validation, documentation, and insight generation
Apply disciplined judgment when evaluating AI-generated outputs, ensuring enterprise standards for accuracy and consistency
Establish practical guardrails for responsible AI usage across both engineering and business consumption
Translate complex and ambiguous business questions into scalable data solutions
Communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to both technical and business stakeholders
Introduce platform and process improvements and drive them through implementation
Influence data standards across the Data & Analytics function

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Embed testing, documentation, and performance optimization into standard engineering practice
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Governance, testing, metric consistency, validation and trust dominate; "greater speed and rigor" pairs speed with rigour rather than favouring it.
evidence.domain_risk: Build durable analytics layers aligned to core revenue and operational domains
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: SaaS revenue and operational analytics with no regulatory or financial-reporting language, so it is moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Lead administration and continuous improvement of the Power BI environment
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An existing Power BI, Snowflake and dbt estate inside a Data & Analytics function is a mid-stage function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Architect and implement dimensional models in Snowflake using dbt
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Bullets name Power BI administration, Snowflake, dbt and KPI governance in context, so a reader knows the day-to-day work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Design reusable, scalable datasets that promote metric consistency across teams
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role owns the BI platform and enterprise metrics that teams across the company consume.
evidence.autonomy_level: You will define modeling standards, evolve our BI platform, formalize enterprise metrics
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role leads the BI platform, defines standards and governs metrics.
evidence.ai_role: Design data models and governance patterns that enable the organization to safely and effectively leverage AI with trusted data
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate designs data models and guardrails for AI consumption as well as using AI, so the tie-breaker gives ai_enabler.
evidence.testing_framing: Embed testing, documentation, and performance optimization into standard engineering practice
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing is a practice the candidate embeds and owns.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Strengthen transparency and trust in enterprise data assets
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trust is named but framed as an improvement goal rather than a risk register, so it is moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Lead administration and continuous improvement of the Power BI environment
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The work strengthens, formalises and improves an existing platform, so it is fix_scale.
evidence.loss_aversion: trust in enterprise data assets — an improvement goal.
